subject: Zeta Corp offsite — scheduling, access windows, and hybrid setup
messages:
From: Elena Varga <elena.varga@zetacorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Zeta Events <events@zetacorp.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: Zeta offsite — dates and site access windows

Hi Marcus / Monica,

Hope you’re well — excited to get the offsite with our platform and product teams scheduled. We’re targeting a two-day executive workshop in Berlin and want to align on dates, arrival windows, and building access. High-level asks: 

- Can Redwood hold calendar slots for June 22–23 and backup June 29–30? We’ll confirm a final date by Friday.
- We need an in-person room for up to 28 people, plus a Zoom room for remote EMEA/US participants.
- Venue access rules: all guests need pre-registered badge names 48 hours ahead. Can you confirm Redwood can supply an onsite host and a badge CSV template?

I’m attaching our draft attendee list and venue access doc (stubs) — the events team included.

Thanks,
Elena Varga
Director, Platform Programs | Zeta Corp
elena.varga@zetacorp.com

Attachments: Zeta_AttendeeList_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 14KB); Venue_Access_Instructions.docx (docx, 22KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@zetacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-30T10:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Zeta offsite — dates and site access windows

Thanks Elena — happy to coordinate. High level answers and next steps: 

- We can provision calendar holds for both date pairs you suggested (June 22–23 and backup June 29–30). I’ve created tentative all-day holds on behalf of the Redwood workshop team; please let me know which one you lock.
- Proposed onsite/hybrid cadence (rough):
  * Day 1: Executive briefing (09:00–12:00 CET), working lunch, breakout labs (13:30–17:00 CET), optional partner dinner 19:00 CET
  * Day 2: Product deep-dive (09:30–12:30 CET), integration sessions, close by 16:00 CET
- We’ll provide an onsite Redwood host and can fill the badge CSV. Please confirm final attendee names 48 hours before arrival.
- AV/streaming: we recommend a single room with dual-camera stream + back-of-room monitor for remote attendees. Monica is looping in AV specifics below.

I attached our Redwood_PreVisit_Checklist.pdf for your review (AV/rooms/parking/shipping). Also adding HubSpot deal link for tracking: https://hubspot.com/deal/ZN-8421.

If that schedule looks good, can you confirm expected headcount and whether any execs need remote-only access (so we size streaming capacity)?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_PreVisit_Checklist.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

Subject: Re: Zeta offsite — dates and site access windows

Adding AV and room setup notes — tagging Aditya for travel/logistics. Quick checks from our ops side: 

- Room configuration: theater for executive brief, then cabaret-style tables for breakout labs (4 tables of 6). We’ll need 2 breakout whiteboards and a flip chart.
- Streaming: dual HDMI feeds, two USB-C capture devices, and a wired backup laptop. Bandwidth test recommended 24 hours before the event.
- Onsite host: Redwood can provide a host + an AV tech for both days. We’ll collect badge CSV 48 hrs prior and submit to venue security.
- Catering: we typically ask for boxed lunch options plus one plated executive lunch — let events know dietary restrictions.

Aditya — can you confirm availability for shuttle pickup from Berlin Tegel (or alternate recommended airport) and confirm hotel partner contacts?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Zeta offsite — dates and site access windows

I can take point on travel logistics and venue gating. Notes and asks: 

- Shuttle / arrival: we can arrange two shuttle waves from airport to hotel (09:00–11:00 CET and 15:00–17:00 CET). Recommend flight arrival no later than 14:00 CET on Day 0 for rehearsal time.
- Hotel: I’m checking availability with the hotel partner — will confirm rooms and a negotiated rate by EOD Wed.
- Security/venue access: we need full legal names and passport country for any external attendees requiring badges. Please add those to the Badge_Request_Template.csv I attached.
- Shipping: if you’re sending any hardware, we need receiver name/contact and expected arrival window — please coordinate with Venue_Access_Instructions.docx.

I’ve attached Badge_Request_Template.csv for Elena to populate. Once we have the attendee list I’ll submit to venue security and lock the shuttle windows.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Partnerships Operations | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Thanks everyone — confirmation below. We’ll go with June 22–23 for the on-site. Final attendee list is attached (names + passport countries). A few quick items: 

- Headcount: 26 onsite, 8 remote. Two execs will dial in (remote-only).
- Catering: please arrange two vegetarian lunches and one kosher meal; I’ll share dietary notes in the attendee sheet.
- Badge CSV: completed and uploaded — Badge_Request_Template.csv attached.
- Venue contact: Thomas Berger (venue manager) — thomas@berlinvenues.de, mobile +49 170 555 0123. Please liaise on door access.

Marcus — can you confirm you’ll send calendar invites and block the rooms once shuttle/hotel are confirmed? Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elena Varga
Director, Platform Programs | Zeta Corp
elena.varga@zetacorp.com
